title: Crimson Skies, GTA San Andreas (two soak titles; see runs)

arms.A (Smart, already run): Part A's MAX runs of sustain507-regimen.json, not re-run: f82e7e87fe, --env PERF_REGIMEN=max, performance_mode 2 (HIGH), fan_mode 4 (Smart), from gate-admitted warm starts. Crimson 1-1790572031-lane.sustain507-4130828 (xo start 63.8 C, first pause 364-399 s from start, 68 % of samples paused) and GTA SA 1-1790572031-lane.sustain507-4130959 (63.5 C, 288-321 s, 76 %). Those runs predate the fan duty column (#554); lane.fanduty507 measured Smart at a median duty of 38000 of 50000 at xo-therm 70-75 C under real titles on the Thor.
arms.B (Customize 100): The same apk, f82e7e87fe, --env PERF_REGIMEN=max --env FAN_MODE=customize:100: performance_mode 2 (HIGH, where the Quick Settings fan tile shows Customize) and the tile's slider at 100, fan_mode 6, duty 50000 (full fan; measured by lane.fanduty507, #571). The idle halt at its default (OFF), as in A. The fan setting is the only intended independent variable.

runs: Thor only, priority 1 (HAKUX_RELEASE_PRIO=1), one B run per title, each through soak_title.sh's normal cool-down gate (#519: xo-therm under 65 C), so from the same warm-start band as A (58-65 C). Crimson Skies - High Road to Revenge (USA) (En,Fr,De,Zh,Ko).xiso.iso, route crimson-skies, 1950 s, first; then 54540082-Grand_Theft_Auto_San_Andreas.xiso.iso, route gta-sa, 2100 s. The seconds are A's, so the window (1800 s after `mark gameplay`) is the same. GTA is the second title because its A run paused earliest and spent the most time paused (76 %): it is the hardest case for the fan. SCORING ADMISSION, fixed now: a B run is scored for H1/H2 only if it starts at xo-therm >= 56.0 C or with the battery sensor >= 37.0 C (A started at 63.5-63.8 C with the battery at 38-40 C). A colder start is reported and not scored, because Part C showed a cold Thor sustains Blinx at the defaults with the Smart fan, so a cold B run cannot separate the fan from the start. Not run here: Sport (a fixed 25000, below Smart's hot median; it cannot beat Smart) and the cold-start pair, which waits on the owner's top-up.
reader: python3 docs/lanes/sustain507/regimen_read.py <run> (per run: fps median and p10 over the window, stability, first pause from start and from mark, xo start / battery start / xo max / plateau, net_w, j_per_frame, fan_duty_median, fan_duty_ge45000_pct, fan_request) and python3 docs/lanes/sustain507/regimen_read.py --halt <B run> <A run> for P (net_w of both over [mark, mark + S], S the shorter pre-pause span; its `cut_w` is A - B, so the fan's cost is -cut_w). At the commit that adds this file. title_verdict.py is also run on a copy of each B result dir and its verdict is reported beside the legs.

legs.L0 (instrument; a run failing it is VOID: perf_regimen.json reads regimen max, perf_mode 2, and a non-null fan_request that ran fan_mode 6 at customize 100, with `moved` 0; thermal.jsonl reads duty >= 45000 in >= 90 % of the window's samples (fan_duty_ge45000_pct); `mark gameplay` present; the window is >= 1740 s; thermal coverage None; sign_suspect 0. FAILS in a world where the dispatcher does not honour FAN_MODE (fan_request null, duty at Smart's curve), the OEM app puts Smart back mid-run (a charger plug event), or the route loses gameplay.
legs.H1 (full fan holds MAX under the pause): Per scored title: B has no thermal pause from its start through mark + 1800 s. One title passing is evidence; both passing decides that the Customize 100 setting sustains these titles at MAX from a warm start. REFUTED per title if B pauses inside the window.
legs.H2 (if B pauses, it pauses later): Judged only for a title that fails H1: B's first pause `after` bound (from start) is >= 300 s later than A's `by` bound (Crimson: >= 699 s; GTA: >= 621 s). REFUTED if it is not: then full fan does not move the trip at MAX by 5 minutes, and airflow is not what limits the Thor.
legs.H3 (plateau under the trip): For a title that passes H1: xo-therm plateaus (regimen_read's plateau rule) at 70.0-76.5 C. REFUTED in value if the plateau is above 76.5 C (a run that is one ambient degree from the trip is not a sustainable margin) or if there is no plateau inside the window. The plateau minute is reported; it sets the confirmation length at this setting.
legs.F (fps where not paused): Crimson: B's window median >= 28.5 (0.95 x 30, the Playable bar) and p10 >= 25. GTA: B's window median >= 0.9 x A's clean-span median (25.0 -> >= 22.5). REFUTED per title if not: then full fan kept the pause off but something else (another mitigation, kgsl devfreq caps) took the frames.
legs.P (the fan's own draw): net_w over the same pre-pause span [mark, mark + S] (regimen_read --halt B A): B - A in [-0.3, +0.6] W. The fan at full is a small load, and a cooler SoC leaks less. REFUTED if B - A > 0.6 W (full fan costs more than its share of the budget) or < -0.3 W (then something besides the fan changed between the arms). Under 120 s of shared span the leg is unreadable. j_per_frame over the whole window is reported beside it and is not the leg, because A's pause lowers A's draw.
legs.FALSIFIER: The world in which the Thor's heat limit at MAX is not the fan's speed: L0 holds (duty 50000 throughout), and B still pauses on both titles within 5 minutes of A's first pause (H1 and H2 both refuted on both titles). Then conduction from the SoC to the heatsink, or the chassis's surface, is the limit, and no user fan setting makes MAX sustainable from a warm start.

battery_capacity: Not assumed, as in sustain507-regimen.json: the hours column is reported only if the pooled capacity range is narrow.
what_this_cannot_see: One B run per title, compared with A runs from earlier in the day (03:30-06:30 PDT) at an unrecorded ambient; a warmer afternoon room works against B. The start band is the gate's, so the starts will differ by a few degrees; both are reported. Since #571 the cool-down gate runs with the screen asleep, which A's runs did not; that changes the gate's wait, not the admitted temperature. Fan noise, the trade-off, is not measured. Nothing here speaks for the Nova (Customize tops out at 35000 there).
expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures, so there is no golden key. The legs are read with regimen_read.py off logcat.txt, thermal.jsonl and perf_regimen.json. arms.sh skips soak predictions (title set); this lane queues them with request.sh.
